# copyright year

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:copyrightYear`](gmeow-copyrightYear.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/copyrightYear>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The year copyright was asserted ([schema:copyrightYear](https://schema.org/copyrightYear)). Typed [rdfs:Literal](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) in the TBox to stay OWL 2 DL ([xsd:gYear](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#gYear) is not an OWL 2 datatype); data carries an [xsd:gYear](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#gYear) value.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:copyrightYear`](gmeow-copyrightYear.md) from [`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the year copyright was asserted ([schema:copyrightYear](https://schema.org/copyrightYear)) on a [`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) relator.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for a validity window (that is [`gmeow:validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md)) and avoid asserting [xsd:gYear](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#gYear) in the TBox; it is typed [rdfs:Literal](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) here, with the gYear value carried in data.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:copyrightYear`](gmeow-copyrightYear.md) once per [`Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) (functional) to a gYear-typed literal in data; pair it with [`gmeow:copyrightNotice`](gmeow-copyrightNotice.md) for the human-readable © line.

### Examples

- ex:reportCopyright [`gmeow:copyrightYear`](gmeow-copyrightYear.md) "2026"^^[xsd:gYear.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#gYear.)
